inputs.description: バージョンの上げ幅を選択

tasks.label: docker: build
tasks.command: VERSION=$(python3 -c "import tomllib; print(tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb'))['project']['version'])") && echo "Building tkgling/kanade:${VERSION}" && docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t tkgling/kanade:${VERSION} -t tkgling/kanade:latest .

tasks.label: docker: push
tasks.command: VERSION=$(python3 -c "import tomllib; print(tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb'))['project']['version'])") && echo "Pushing tkgling/kanade:${VERSION} + latest" && docker push tkgling/kanade:${VERSION} && docker push tkgling/kanade:latest

tasks.label: version: bump
tasks.command:
python3 -c "
import tomllib, re, sys
level = '${input:bumpLevel}'
with open('pyproject.toml', 'rb') as f:
    data = tomllib.load(f)
old = data['project']['version']
major, minor, patch = (int(x) for x in old.split('.'))
if level == 'major':
    major, minor, patch = major+1, 0, 0
elif level == 'minor':
    minor, patch = minor+1, 0
else:
    patch += 1
new = f'{major}.{minor}.{patch}'
with open('pyproject.toml', 'r') as f:
    text = f.read()
text = text.replace(f'version = \"{ old }\"', f'version = \"{new}\"', 1)
with open('pyproject.toml', 'w') as f:
    f.write(text)
print(f'{old} -> {new}')
"
